text: Bitcoin's 7.3% surge is outpacing Ethereum's 3.9% gain, reflecting a risk-on mood where investors are rotating toward the largest and most liquid asset. The Fear & Greed index at 72 with a sharp 43-point weekly rise signals aggressive optimism, though Bitcoin's growing dominance to 59.3% suggests confidence is narrowing rather than broadening across the ecosystem. Trading volume at $351B indicates genuine participation backing these moves, not hollow price action.
